source_title: Substack Vs Patreon Which Fosters Better Community
snippet_primary: "Patreon started with a different premise: patronage. It's a platform for fans to directly support creators they love in exchange for… well, whatever the creator wants to offer. This leads to a fundamentally different community structure. It's not about a single publication; it's about access to a creator's world."
subject_exact: Premisa de Patreon descrita como patronage: soporte directo de fans a creadores a cambio de lo que el creador quiera ofrecer, con estructura de comunidad centrada en el acceso al mundo del creador y no en una publicación única
